why: Our own live collection as the marketplace renders it — listing state, floor, trait display. The baseline every new drop is measured against.
The Silicon Bayou contract on Robinhood Chain (4663) — holders, transfers, verified source. Ground truth for on-chain activity.
Robinhood chain docs — RPC endpoints, chain behavior, platform rules that constrain a drop. Use --crawl with a small --limit.
Floor prices across major collections — the reference frame for pricing a new drop honestly.
Cross-chain NFT sales volume rankings — which chains and collections actually move, not which ones are loud.
